scripts.android:run: cd apps/android && ./gradlew :app:installDebug && adb shell am start -n ai.openclaw.android/.MainActivity
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:gen && git diff --exit-code -- apps/macos/Sources/OpenClawProtocol/GatewayModels.swift apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawProtocol/GatewayModels.swift apps/macos/Sources/OpenClaw/HostEnvSecurityPolicy.generated.swift && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts scripts/contracts.test.ts
scripts.ios:build: bash -lc './scripts/ios-configure-signing.sh && cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination "${IOS_DEST:-platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17}" -configuration Debug build'
scripts.ios:open: bash -lc './scripts/ios-configure-signing.sh && cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && open OpenClaw.xcodeproj'
scripts.ios:run: bash -lc './scripts/ios-configure-signing.sh && cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination "${IOS_DEST:-platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17}" -configuration Debug build && xcrun simctl boot "${IOS_SIM:-iPhone 17}" || true && xcrun simctl launch booted ai.openclaw.ios'
scripts.ios:ci: cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
